title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #16

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which action shows obedience to school rules? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Keeping the compound clean
   C. Leaving without permission
   D. Coming late

2. What does the woman's search teach us about money? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it always
   B. Lose it quickly
   C. Money is unimportant
   D. Money is valuable and should be looked after

3. How many books are in the whole Bible? (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 66
   C. 39
   D. 100

4. Zawadi is a Kiswahili name. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. A gift
   B. A river
   C. A mountain
   D. A road

5. Which command did Jesus give in John 13:34? (1 mark)
   A. Love one another
   B. Fast
   C. Go to the temple
   D. Give money

6. Which Bible passage says that we are fearfully and wonderfully made? (1 mark)
   A. Matthew 6
   B. Psalm 139
   C. Numbers 22
   D. Acts 2

7. Which verse warns about bad company? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. 1 Corinthians 15:33
   D. John 3:16

8. What does a seed need to grow? (1 mark)
   A. Soil, water and light
   B. Only noise
   C. Nothing
   D. Only sand

9. What does it mean to honour your parents? (1 mark)
   A. To respect them, obey them and thank them
   B. To ignore them
   C. To hide from them
   D. To argue with them

10. Which person is showing gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. A child who complains
   B. A child who laughs
   C. A child who forgets to thank
   D. A child who thanks her neighbour for a kind act

11. What did the angel tell Balaam to do at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Kill the donkey
   B. Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   C. Curse Israel
   D. Go home forever

12. Which people ruled the Israelites during Samson's time? (1 mark)
   A. The Egyptians
   B. The Greeks
   C. The Philistines
   D. The Romans

13. Which of these shows love at school? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing at new pupils
   B. Hiding books
   C. Welcoming a new pupil
   D. Refusing to greet

14. Which is a good habit in prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Never praying
   B. Praying only when scared
   C. Praying morning and evening
   D. Praying only in church

15. Which commandment says, "Honour your father and your mother"? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:15
   B. Exodus 20:3
   C. Exodus 20:16
   D. Exodus 20:12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe how Zacchaeus met Jesus and how his behaviour changed. (4 marks)

17. Give two people you should pray for. (2 marks)

18. Give three ways in which a child can protect themselves from sexual abuse. (3 marks)

19. Describe four steps of how to pray. (4 marks)

20. State two things that the story of Jesus blessing children teaches. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Keeping the compound clean
   Following rules shows responsibility.

2. D — Money is valuable and should be looked after
   The woman valued her coin.

3. B — 66
   39 + 27 = 66.

4. A — A gift
   Zawadi means a gift in Kiswahili.

5. A — Love one another
   Jesus said to love as He loved.

6. B — Psalm 139
   Psalm 139:14 speaks of being fearfully and wonderfully made.

7. C — 1 Corinthians 15:33
   Bad company corrupts good character.

8. A — Soil, water and light
   Seeds need soil, water and light.

9. A — To respect them, obey them and thank them
   Honouring includes respect, obedience and thankfulness.

10. D — A child who thanks her neighbour for a kind act
   Saying thank you shows gratitude.

11. B — Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   God allowed him to go but ordered him to speak only His words.

12. C — The Philistines
   The Philistines oppressed Israel in the days of Samson.

13. C — Welcoming a new pupil
   Welcoming is kind.

14. C — Praying morning and evening
   Regular prayer builds faith.

15. D — Exodus 20:12
   Exodus 20:12 is the commandment on honouring parents.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: Zacchaeus climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus called him by name and went to his house. Zacchaeus promised to give half his goods to the poor and to repay four times anyone he had cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for climbing the tree, 1 for Jesus calling him, 1 for giving to the poor, 1 for repaying.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Parents, guardians, friends, teachers, sick people, leaders.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, run away, do not accept gifts from strangers, avoid being alone in hidden places, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Find a quiet moment, speak with respect, thank Him, say sorry, ask for help, say Amen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step up to 4.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves children; children are important; they are welcome in God's kingdom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.
